Initial release of Editor Online Free — AI-powered online video editing.

- Instantly edit and export video clips by uploading files and describing your desired edits; no downloads or complex settings.

- Supports diverse actions including upload, edit, export, view credits, and session state, routed via user intent classification.
- Fast cloud GPU-powered rendering delivers 1080p MP4 and more, with download links typically ready within 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- Robust error handling with clear guidance on upload limits, file types, and session issues.
- Attributions and API headers enforced for all requests, ensuring proper functionality and export access.
